# Shared Conventions

These instructions apply to all files in this repository.

- Think before coding. State assumptions, surface ambiguity, and ask rather than guess.
- Keep solutions simple. Do not add speculative features or unnecessary abstraction.
- Make surgical changes. Touch only what is needed, match existing style, and clean up only the orphans your change creates.
- Plan work with explicit verification criteria before implementation.
- Follow house rules: no em dashes, use AskUserQuestion for blocking ambiguity, write summaries to `do-work/summaries/`, and use Conventional Commits.

For full details, read the relevant file from `.claude/conventions/` before coding. Common references include `<lang>-style.md`, `markdown-style.md`, `commit-style.md`, and `do-work-protocol.md`.
